page.overview:
What is Attack on Cin Tykan's expedition?

In 3643 BBY, the Death's Claw pirate organization undertook an attack on the research expedition led by Master Cin Tykan. Most of the expedition was killed, with the exception of astromech droid T8-C3 and an advance group of researchers taken away by Tykan before the attack.
